# Alloq

Ressourcen- und Kapazitätsplanung für Softwareteams. Dieses Design System ist aus dem Code der Anwendung abgeleitet: `assets/css/alloq-theme.css`, `app/styles.py`, das Mantine-Theme in `app/app.py` und die Komponenten unter `components/` und `app/components/`. Die UI läuft auf Reflex mit Mantine (`appkit_mantine`). Das Theme legt die eigenen `--alloq-*` Variablen und umgefärbte Mantine-Paletten über die Standardwerte.

## Content Fundamentals

- **Sprache:** Deutsch, sachlich, kurze Wörter. Navigation, Buttons, Status und Meldungen sind deutsch: „Ressourcenplanung“, „Projekt anlegen“, „Abbrechen“, „Keine offenen Risiken.“
- **Titel:** kurze Substantive („Feiertage“, „Projekt Details“). Darüber ein Breadcrumb, darunter höchstens ein Satz Beschreibung.
- **Buttons:** Verb oder Verb mit Objekt. Die Hauptaktion eines Modals nennt das Objekt: „Projekt speichern“.
- **Kennzahlen:** Labels in Versalien („AUSLASTUNG“, „PT FREI“), die Zahl ist die Aussage.
- **Zahlen und Daten:** deutsches Format. Beträge „480.000 €“, kurz „1,2M €“ oder „850T €“. Daten „TT.MM.JJJJ“ oder „1. Sep 2026“. Kalenderwochen „KW 42“. Personentage „PT“.
- **Leere Zustände** sagen, was fehlt, mit Punkt am Ende.
- Keine Ausrufezeichen, keine Emojis.

## Visual Foundations

- **Ton:** warm und ruhig. Ein cremeweißer Grund (`bg-base`) trägt einen weichen Verlauf aus Gold, Salbeigrün, Lavendel und Teal. Im dunklen Modus wird der Grund zu tiefem Petrol (`#141e21`) mit dunklen Blau-, Grün- und Violetttönen.
- **Farbe:** Die Mantine-Primärpalette ist `alloqTeal` (Stufe 6 hell, 7 dunkel). Teal ist die Handlungsfarbe (`primary-filled`, `nav-active-bg`). Gold (`warm-*`, Palette `alloqWarm`) ist die Markenfarbe für Flächen und die Radix-Akzente, nie für kleinen Text. Salbei, Gelb, Terrakotta und Rot tragen Status. Alle Mantine-Paletten außer Violett sind auf diese gedämpften Töne umgefärbt.
- **Flächen:** Karten sind halbtransparent (`fade-bg`, `surface`) und lassen den Verlauf durchscheinen. Modale, Drawer, Tabellenköpfe und das Planungsraster sind deckend (`surface-muted`, `surface-solid`).
- **Rahmen statt Schatten:** Linien in blassem Grün (`border`). Schatten nur für schwebende Elemente (`shadow-soft`), Formularabschnitte und die Modal-Fußzeile.
- **Radien:** `radius-sm` für Tabellen, Raster und Balken, `radius-md` für Eingaben und Buttons, `radius-lg` für Karten, Modale und Drawer, `radius-xl` für Badges und Fortschrittsbalken.
- **Typografie:** Roboto Flex für alles, Roboto Mono für Code, Major Mono Display nur für das Wortzeichen. Seitentitel sind sehr leicht (280, 3rem), Kennzahlen kräftig (700), Namen in Karten 800.
- **Daten:** Tabellenziffern in Rastern und Tabellen. Die aktuelle Woche ist golden hinterlegt (`current-week`).
- **Bewegung:** nur Hintergrundübergänge von 120 bis 200ms bei Hover und ein Skelett-Schimmer beim Laden.

## Iconography

Lucide über `rx.icon`, Strichstärke 1.5px (gesetzt in `base_style`). Größen: 20px in Buttons der Größe `md` und in der Navigation, 16px in Feldern und Kartentiteln, 14px in kleinen Aktionen, 48px in leeren Zuständen. Icons tragen die Textfarbe ihrer Umgebung. Icon-Schaltflächen haben immer ein `aria-label` und einen Tooltip. Die Vorschauen laden die genutzten Lucide-Pfade aus `icons/lucide.js` (aus `lucide-react` 1.26.0).

## Usage Rules

1. Text in `text` oder `text-muted` auf `bg-base`, `surface`, `surface-muted` oder `fade-bg`. `text-muted` nicht unter 11px.
2. Pro Ansicht ein gefüllter Button (`primary-filled` mit `nav-active-text`). Gold ist keine Buttonfarbe: weißer Text erreicht darauf nur 1.8:1.
3. Status immer als Paar aus Grund und Text: Badge-Grund `*-light`, Text `*-7` (dunkel `*-3`). Das Wort steht immer im Badge.
4. Auslastung nutzt die `heat-*` Stufen, Wochensummen die `cap-*` Stufen, Risiken die `risk-*` Skala. Die Zahl steht immer in der Zelle.
5. Diagrammreihen nutzen die `chart-*` Tokens. Prognosen sind gestrichelt.
6. Löschen nur mit Bestätigungsdialog.
7. Seiteninhalt höchstens `content-max-width` breit. Die Planungsansichten füllen den Platz zwischen Navigation und rechtem Rand.
8. Neue Farben zuerst als Token in `alloq-theme.css` anlegen, hell und dunkel zusammen.

## Komponenten

Die Komponentenseiten zeigen statische Nachbauten in HTML und CSS. Die Stile stehen in `components/bundle.css` (Klassen `aq-*`) und nutzen nur Tokens.

| Gruppe | Komponenten |
| --- | --- |
| Actions | Button, ActionIcon |
| Inputs | TextInput, Select, Switch |
| Navigation | Navigation, SegmentedControl, ViewModeToggle, Tabs |
| Layout | PageHeader, Toolbar, FilterRow, FormSection |
| Data display | Badge, Avatar, Progress, DataTable |
| Cards | ProjectCard, EmployeeCard |
| Dashboard | KpiCard, CapacityCard, RiskList, ForecastChart |
| Planning | PlanningGrid, Heatmap, Gantt, RiskMatrix |
| Overlays | ModalDrawer, ConfirmDialog, UserMenu, Tooltip |
| Feedback | EmptyState |

## Not synced

- Der Seitenverlauf `--alloq-app-bg` besteht aus fünf Radialverläufen und lässt sich nicht als Token abbilden. Er steht in `assets/css/alloq-theme.css`.
- Die Radix-Variablen (`--accent-*`, `--blue-*` usw.) und die vollständigen Mantine-Skalen 0 bis 9 sind nur teilweise als Tokens übernommen.
- Die Reflex-Komponenten selbst sind nicht gebündelt. Die Vorschauen sind Nachbauten.
- Violett (`cap-tight`, Prognosen) und Blau 0 bis 1 (`cap-absent`) sind Mantine-Standardfarben und passen nicht zur gedämpften Palette.
- Einige Texte sind noch englisch („Search by name“, „Planned Value“).
- `assets/img/logo.svg` enthält ein fremdes Wortzeichen (Voyager) und wurde nicht übernommen.

"""Position inclusive absence periods on the shared weekly planning timeline."""

from datetime import date, timedelta

from alloq_commons.models.employee import Employee

from alloq_project.states.planning_models import (
    WEEK_COL_PX,
    AbsenceGanttBar,
    AbsenceGanttRow,
    EmployeeBlock,
    WeekColumn,
)

GANTT_LANE_PX = 28
GANTT_PADDING_PX = 8
GANTT_MIN_ROW_PX = 56
CALENDAR_DAYS_PER_WEEK = 7


def _week_date(week: WeekColumn) -> date:
    return date.fromisoformat(week.key.replace("_", "-"))


def build_absence_gantt(
    resources: list[EmployeeBlock],
    employees: list[Employee],
    weeks: list[WeekColumn],
) -> list[AbsenceGanttRow]:
    """Show resources with overlapping absences, clipped to the displayed range."""
    if not weeks:
        return []
    horizon_start = _week_date(weeks[0])
    horizon_end = _week_date(weeks[-1]) + timedelta(days=CALENDAR_DAYS_PER_WEEK)
    px_per_day = WEEK_COL_PX / CALENDAR_DAYS_PER_WEEK
    by_id = {employee.id: employee for employee in employees}
    rows: list[AbsenceGanttRow] = []
    for resource in resources:
        employee = by_id.get(resource.real_id)
        periods = sorted(
            (
                (absence.start_date, absence.end_date)
                for absence in (employee.absences if employee else [])
                if absence.start_date is not None
                and absence.end_date is not None
                and absence.start_date <= absence.end_date
                and absence.start_date < horizon_end
                and absence.end_date >= horizon_start
            ),
        )
        if not periods:
            continue
        lane_ends: list[date] = []
        bars: list[AbsenceGanttBar] = []
        for start, end in periods:
            visible_start = max(start, horizon_start)
            visible_end = min(end + timedelta(days=1), horizon_end)
            lane = next(
                (
                    i
                    for i, lane_end in enumerate(lane_ends)
                    if lane_end <= visible_start
                ),
                len(lane_ends),
            )
            if lane == len(lane_ends):
                lane_ends.append(visible_end)
            else:
                lane_ends[lane] = visible_end
            days = (end - start).days + 1
            duration = "1 Kalendertag" if days == 1 else f"{days} Kalendertage"
            bars.append(
                AbsenceGanttBar(
                    left_px=(visible_start - horizon_start).days * px_per_day,
                    width_px=(visible_end - visible_start).days * px_per_day,
                    lane=lane,
                    label=f"{start:%d.%m.} - {end:%d.%m.}",
                    tooltip=(
                        f"{resource.name}\n{start:%d.%m.%Y} - {end:%d.%m.%Y}"
                        f"\n{duration}"
                    ),
                )
            )
        rows.append(
            AbsenceGanttRow(
                real_id=resource.real_id,
                name=resource.name,
                job_title=resource.job_title,
                bars=bars,
                height_px=max(
                    GANTT_MIN_ROW_PX,
                    len(lane_ends) * GANTT_LANE_PX + GANTT_PADDING_PX * 2,
                ),
            )
        )
    return rows

class PlanningAbsenceState(rx.State):

            "height": "100%",

        mn.center(
            mn.group(rx.spinner(size="3"), mn.text("Lade Abwesenheiten...", size="sm")),
            py="xl",
        ),
    )

"""Design tokens and the Mantine theme: the macOS look, light and dark.

All colors live here. Components use the CSS variables (`token("border")`,
`TEXT`, ...) or the Mantine palette `blue`. `TOKENS` holds the light values,

window draws the sidebar with native vibrancy; the browser shows
`window-background` instead (see `GLOBAL_CSS`).

The old `--alloq-*` variables stay as aliases (`LEGACY_ALIASES`) until every
component uses the tokens directly.
"""

input.recap: The redesign proposal for the Abwesenheiten view is on a design canvas, with the full view and a sheet of bar states. Nothing in the code has changed, and I haven't checked how the canvas looks.

content.text:
I put the redesign proposal on a design canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/8WUwBKpKgpyHmUe5UHKqge

It has two boards. "Abwesenheiten – Vorschlag" is the whole view in dark mode, using your three real absences. "Balken-Zustände" shows how each kind of bar is drawn. You can switch both to light mode in Tweaks, and you can hide the details popup.

**What changes compared to the screenshot**

- **Bar labels are always readable.** Today a 2‑day bar shows only "2" and Charly's says "21.12...". In the proposal, a wide bar shows its dates inside. A narrow bar shows "21.–25.12. · 4 AT" next to it instead. A bar that started before the visible range gets a straight left edge and says "seit 28.09.".
- **Each column shows single days.** The scale is 7 px per day, so you can see where an absence starts and ends inside a week. Weekends are shaded, public holidays are hatched (25.12. and 01.01.), and a red line marks today.
- **New "Besetzung" row.** For each week it shows the lowest number of people present on any one day, like "2/3" or "1/3". Weeks where people are missing are colored. In KW 52 only 1 of 3 is present, so that week is tinted, and a "1 Engpass · KW 52" chip in the toolbar jumps to it.
- **"Summe" column.** It shows each person's working days off in the range and when their next absence starts.
- **Clicking a bar opens details:** working days, calendar days, which holidays were not counted, a warning about overlaps with colleagues, and buttons for Bearbeiten and Löschen.
- **You add an absence by dragging in a row.** A dashed outline shows the dates and working days while you drag. The main button in the header becomes "Abwesenheit eintragen" in this tab instead of "Projekt planen".
- **Simpler toolbar.** I removed "Projekte", "Nur verfügbare" and "Interne & Abwesenheit ausblenden", because they do nothing useful in this view. I added Heute with ‹ › buttons to move through time, and a switch "Ganzes Team zeigen" so people with no absences also get a row to drag in.
- **Smaller rows and lighter headers.** Rows are 52 px with small avatars instead of about 80 px. The bright blue month row became a quiet grey header that also shows the KW numbers.
- **A "Nächste Abwesenheiten" list under the grid**, with "in 4 Tagen" and similar labels, so you can scan upcoming absences without reading the timeline.

**Assumptions**

- **Colors and fonts:** I took them from the current tokens in [theme.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/theme.py) (blue accent, system font). I did not use your saved "Alloq" design system, because it still has the old teal and gold colors and no longer matches the app.
- **Holidays:** I used the national German ones.
- **Counting:** working days are Monday to Friday, minus holidays.
- **Absence types:** absences have no type yet, such as vacation or sick leave, so all bars are one color.

The canvas is private, so others can't open the link until you share it from its Share menu.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import reflex as rx
from alloq_project.states.planning_models import (

)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from alloq_project.states.planning_models import WeekColumn

NORMAL = "normal"
COMPACT = "kompakt"


class PlanningDisplayState(rx.State, mixin=True):
    """Row density and column layout of the planning grids.

    A mixin rather than a substate: the grid components read these vars next to
    `PlanningStore` vars, and the density must survive reloads per browser.
    """

    if TYPE_CHECKING:  # Provided by PlanningStore.
        weeks: list[WeekColumn]

    grid_density: str = rx.LocalStorage(NORMAL, name="alloq_planning_density")

    @rx.event
    def toggle_grid_density(self) -> None:
        self.grid_density = NORMAL if self.grid_density == COMPACT else COMPACT

    @rx.var(cache=True)
    def is_compact(self) -> bool:
        return self.grid_density == COMPACT

    @rx.var(cache=True)
    def week_col_px(self) -> int:
        return COMPACT_WEEK_COL_PX if self.grid_density == COMPACT else WEEK_COL_PX

    @rx.var(cache=True)
    def table_width(self) -> str:
        return f"{LABEL_COL_PX + len(self.weeks) * self.week_col_px}px"

    @rx.var(cache=True)
    def grid_template_columns(self) -> str:
        return f"{LABEL_COL_PX}px repeat({len(self.weeks)}, {self.week_col_px}px)"

    @rx.var(cache=True)
    def month_start_keys(self) -> list[str]:
        return [w.key for w in self.weeks if w.is_month_start]

        ),

def format_gesamt(value: rx.Var[float]) -> rx.Component:
    """Format a Gesamt (total) number — always displayed."""
    return de_number(
        value=value,
        decimal_scale=2,
        minimum_fraction_digits=2,
        fixed_decimal_scale=True,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Block header info (pinned beside the label column)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY_TOOLTIP = "Ab der aktuellen Woche bis zum Ende des Zeitraums"
PINNED_END_STYLE = {"right": "0", "marginLeft": "auto"}


def summary_stat(
    label: str, value: rx.Var[float], color: str = "var(--alloq-text)"
) -> rx.Component:
    """Muted label followed by a person-day figure."""
    return mn.group(
        mn.text(label, size="xs", c="var(--alloq-text-muted)"),
        mn.text(
            de_number(
                value=value,
                decimal_scale=2,
                fixed_decimal_scale=True,
                suffix=" PT",
            ),
            size="xs",
            fw="600",
            c=color,
        ),
        gap="4px",
        align="center",
        wrap="nowrap",
    )


def _pinned_group(*children: rx.Component, style: dict) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        *children,
        gap="md",
        align="center",
        wrap="nowrap",
        style={"position": "sticky", "padding": "0 12px", **style},
    )


def _summary_tooltip(content: rx.Component) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.tooltip(content, label=SUMMARY_TOOLTIP, open_delay=400)


def block_header_info_cell(
    *children: rx.Component,
    background: str,
    end: Sequence[rx.Component] = (),
) -> rx.Component:
    """Week-column part of a block header; its content stays horizontally pinned.

    ``children`` pin to the left edge; ``end`` pins to the right edge of the row
    or, when the row is wider than the viewport, to the viewport's right edge.
    """
    start = _pinned_group(*children, style={"left": LABEL_COL_WIDTH})
    pinned = (
        [start, _summary_tooltip(_pinned_group(*end, style=PINNED_END_STYLE))]
        if end
        else [_summary_tooltip(start)]
    )
    return mn.box(
        *pinned,
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            "gridColumn": "2 / -1",
            "justifyContent": "flex-start",
            "padding": "0",
            "backgroundColor": background,
            "borderTop": "1px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
            "borderBottom": "1px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
            "borderRight": "none",
        },
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared header components
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def month_cell(
    month: ObjectVar[MonthSpan], index: NumberVar | None = None
) -> rx.Component:
    """Header cell spanning one month; later months get a separator line."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(month.label, fz="11px", fw="700", c="var(--alloq-text)"),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            "gridColumn": "span " + month.span.to_string(),
            "position": "relative",
            "zIndex": "0",
            "backgroundColor": MONTH_HEADER_BG,
            "fontWeight": "500",
            "justifyContent": "flex-start",
            "paddingLeft": "12px",
            "minHeight": HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT,
            "borderLeft": (
                "none"
                if index is None
                else rx.cond(index > 0, MONTH_START_BORDER, "none")
            ),
        },
    )


def week_label_cell(week: ObjectVar[WeekColumn]) -> rx.Component:
    """Header cell for a week, right-aligned above the numbers."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(week.label, fz="11px", c="var(--alloq-text-muted)", fw="500"),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            **week_cell_style(week.key, "var(--alloq-surface-muted)"),
            "position": "relative",
            "zIndex": "0",
            "minHeight": HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT,
            "fontWeight": "500",
        },
    )


def work_days_cell(week: ObjectVar[WeekColumn]) -> rx.Component:
    """Header cell showing work days, only for weeks shortened by holidays."""
    return mn.box(
        rx.cond(week.is_short, format_de(week.work_days), rx.fragment()),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            **week_cell_style(week.key, "var(--alloq-surface-muted)"),
            "position": "relative",
            "zIndex": "0",
            "minHeight": HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT,
            "backgroundColor": rx.cond(
                week.is_short,
                SHORT_WEEK_BG,
                current_week_bg(week.key, "var(--alloq-surface-muted)"),
            ),
            "fontWeight": "600",
            "fontSize": "11px",
            "borderBottom": "2px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
        },
    )


def label_th(
    text: str, *, accent: bool = False, last: bool = False, hint: str = ""
) -> rx.Component:
    """Sticky label header cell with an optional muted hint."""
    sticky = STICKY_LEFT_HEADER_TOP if accent else STICKY_LEFT_HEADER
    extra = {"borderBottom": "2px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)"} if last else {}
    hint_text = [mn.text(hint, size="xs", c="var(--alloq-text-muted)")] if hint else []
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(text, size="xs", fw="700", c="var(--alloq-text)"),
        *hint_text,
        style={
            **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
            **sticky,
            **extra,
            "gap": "6px",
            "minHeight": HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT,
        },
    )


def header_block() -> rx.Component:
    """Three-row header: months, weeks, work days."""
    return mn.box(
        grid_row(
            label_th("Monat", accent=True),
            rx.foreach(PlanningStore.month_spans, month_cell),
        ),
        grid_row(
            label_th("Woche"),
            rx.foreach(PlanningStore.weeks, week_label_cell),
        ),
        grid_row(
            label_th("Arbeitstage (brutto)", last=True, hint="leer = volle Woche"),
            rx.foreach(PlanningStore.weeks, work_days_cell),
        ),
        style=HEADER_BLOCK_STYLE,
        custom_attrs={"data-grid-header": "true"},
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared value cell (selection/editing handled by ExcelGrid)

GRID_ROOT_STYLE = {**GRID_WRAPPER_STYLE, "outline": "none"}


def planning_excel_grid(*children: rx.Component, grid_id: str) -> rx.Component:
    """Excel-like interaction layer bound to PlanningStore."""
    return excel_grid(
        *children,
        id=grid_id,
        grid_label="Kapazitätsplanung",
        revision=PlanningStore.grid_revision,
        dirty=PlanningStore.has_dirty,
        saving=PlanningStore.is_saving,
        min_value=0,
        decimals=2,
        invalid_message="Ungültige Zahl (≥ 0)",
        on_commit=PlanningStore.apply_cell_changes,
        on_reject=PlanningStore.notify_rejected,
        on_save=PlanningStore.save_grid,
        style={**GRID_ROOT_STYLE, **grid_density_vars()},
    )


def editable_value_cell(cell: ObjectVar[GridCell]) -> rx.Component:
    """Display cell with dirty indicator; ExcelGrid handles interaction."""
    return mn.box(
        format_de(cell.value),
        rx.cond(
            cell.is_dirty,
            mn.box(
                style={
                    "position": "absolute",
                    "top": "3px",
                    "right": "3px",
                    "width": "5px",
                    "height": "5px",
                    "borderRadius": "50%",
                    "backgroundColor": "var(--mantine-color-orange-6)",
                },
            ),
            rx.fragment(),
        ),
        custom_attrs=grid_cell_attrs(cell.key, cell.week_key, cell.value),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            **week_cell_style(cell.week_key),
            "position": "relative",
            "cursor": "cell",
            "userSelect": "none",
            "color": rx.cond(cell.is_repeat, REPEAT_COLOR, "var(--alloq-text)"),
            "_hover": {"backgroundColor": "var(--alloq-surface-hover)"},
        },
    )

    @requires_admin
    async def create_absence(self, form_data: dict) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Create a new absence for the selected employee."""
        _ = form_data  # Reflex requires this keyword arg for on_submit
        logger.debug("create_absence called with data: %s", self.absence_date_range)
        if not self.selected_employee:
            yield rx.toast.error("Kein Mitarbeiter ausgewählt.", position="top-right")
            return

        date_range = _parse_date_range(self.absence_date_range)
        if date_range is None:
            yield rx.toast.error(
                "Bitte einen gültigen Zeitraum auswählen.", position="top-right"
            )
            return
        start, end = date_range

        if start < datetime.now(tz=UTC).date():
            yield rx.toast.error(
                "Abwesenheiten dürfen nicht in der Vergangenheit beginnen.",
                position="top-right",
            )
            return

        try:
            absence_data = AbsenceCreate(
                employee_id=self.selected_employee.id, start_date=start, end_date=end
            )

            async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
                absence_entities = await absence_repo.find_by_employee_id(
                    session, absence_data.employee_id
                )
                # Overlaps would be double-counted in the utilization figures.
                overlaps = any(
                    a.start_date <= end and a.end_date >= start
                    for a in absence_entities
                )
                if not overlaps:
                    entity = AbsenceEntity(
                        employee_id=absence_data.employee_id,
                        start_date=absence_data.start_date,
                        end_date=absence_data.end_date,
                    )
                    await absence_repo.create(session, entity)
                    absence_entities = await absence_repo.find_by_employee_id(
                        session, absence_data.employee_id
                    )

            if overlaps:
                yield rx.toast.error(
                    "Der Zeitraum überschneidet sich mit einer bestehenden "
                    "Abwesenheit.",
                    position="top-right",
                )
                return

            self.absences = [Absence(**a.to_dict()) for a in absence_entities]

            # Reload all employees so the cards update with the new absence
            await self._load_employees()

            self.close_absence_modal()
            yield rx.toast.info("Abwesenheit eingetragen.", position="top-right")

            yield rx.toast.error(

            )

        route=route,
        title=title,
        sidebar=sidebar,
        toolbar=window_toolbar(
            "Ressourcenplanung",
            "Kapazität und Zuweisungen je Woche",
            center=planning_view_switch(),
            actions=planning_toolbar(),

        scope=scope_bar(planning_filter_row()),
        padded=False,

            center=project_filter(),
            actions=project_toolbar(),

        padded=False,
        admin_only=True,
        on_load=[ProjectState.load_projects],

        return requires_admin(project_overview())

    return _projects_overview_page

@pytest.mark.parametrize("saved", [True, False])
async def test_refresh_only_after_saved_absence(saved: bool) -> None:
    state = PlanningAbsenceState()
    team = SimpleNamespace(absence_modal_open=True)
    form_data = {"date_range": ""}
    submitted: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    async def create_absence(data: dict[str, Any]) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        submitted.append(data)
        team.absence_modal_open = not saved

    team.create_absence = create_absence
    with patch.object(PlanningAbsenceState, "get_state", _get_state(team)):
        events = [event async for event in state.create_absence(form_data)]

    assert submitted == [form_data]
    assert (PlanningStore.refresh in events) is saved

    ]

    )

"""Absence timeline of the planning page; mixed into `PlanningStore`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import reflex as rx
from alloq_project.services.planning_gantt import build_absence_gantt
from alloq_project.states.planning_models import AbsenceGanttView

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from alloq_commons.models.employee import Employee
    from alloq_project.states.planning_models import EmployeeBlock, WeekColumn

ABSENCE_VIEW = "Abwesenheiten"


class PlanningAbsenceViewMixin(rx.State, mixin=True):
    """Bars, week coverage and summaries of the absence view.

    A mixin rather than a substate: the view reads the shared filters, weeks
    and employee blocks of `PlanningStore`.
    """

    if TYPE_CHECKING:  # Provided by PlanningStore.
        view_mode: str
        weeks: list[WeekColumn]
        holiday_dates: list[dt.date]
        available_employees: list[Employee]
        employee_blocks: list[EmployeeBlock]

        def _filter_employees(
            self, blocks: list[EmployeeBlock], *, planning_filters: bool = True
        ) -> list[EmployeeBlock]: ...

    absence_show_all: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)

    @rx.event
    def set_absence_show_all(self, value: bool) -> None:
        self.absence_show_all = value

    @rx.var(cache=True)
    def absence_gantt(self) -> AbsenceGanttView:
        if self.view_mode != ABSENCE_VIEW:
            return AbsenceGanttView()
        # Project and availability filters have no control in this view.
        return build_absence_gantt(
            self._filter_employees(self.employee_blocks, planning_filters=False),
            self.available_employees,
            self.weeks,
            holidays=self.holiday_dates,
            today=dt.datetime.now().date(),  # noqa: DTZ005
            show_all=self.absence_show_all,
        )

"""Absence actions of the planning page, built on the shared absence form."""

import datetime as dt
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_project.states.planning_grid_state import PlanningStore
from alloq_team.states.team_state import TeamState

from appkit_user.authentication.decorators import requires_admin


class PlanningAbsenceState(rx.State):
    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def create_absence(self, form_data: dict) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        team = await self.get_state(TeamState)
        if not team.absence_modal_open:
            return
        async for event in team.create_absence(form_data):
            yield event
        if not team.absence_modal_open:
            yield PlanningStore.refresh

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def open_new_absence(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Open the absence form without a preselected employee."""
        team = await self.get_state(TeamState)
        team.selected_employee = None
        team.open_absence_modal()
        yield

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def pick_employee(self, value: str | None) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Choose the employee in the open form; the chosen dates stay."""
        if not value:
            return
        team = await self.get_state(TeamState)
        date_range = list(team.absence_date_range)
        async for event in team.select_employee_and_add_absence(int(value)):
            yield event
        team.absence_date_range = date_range

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def start_absence(
        self, employee_id: int, start_day: int, end_day: int
    ) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Open the form for a range dragged on the absence timeline.

        Day numbers count from the first displayed day.
        """
        planning = await self.get_state(PlanningStore)
        horizon = planning.absence_gantt.horizon_start
        if not horizon:
            return
        first = dt.date.fromisoformat(horizon)
        start = first + dt.timedelta(days=min(start_day, end_day))
        end = first + dt.timedelta(days=max(start_day, end_day))
        if start < dt.datetime.now(tz=dt.UTC).date():
            yield rx.toast.error(
                "Abwesenheiten dürfen nicht in der Vergangenheit beginnen.",
                position="top-right",
            )
            return
        team = await self.get_state(TeamState)
        async for event in team.select_employee_and_add_absence(employee_id):
            yield event
        team.absence_date_range = [start.isoformat(), end.isoformat()]

    @rx.event
    @requires_admin
    async def delete_absence(self, absence_id: int) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        team = await self.get_state(TeamState)
        async for event in team.delete_absence(absence_id):
            yield event
        yield PlanningStore.refresh

Some components override this: | Component | on_change receives | Pattern | |---|---|---| | TextInput, PasswordInput, Textarea | event object | `on_change=State.set_value` (standard) | | NumberInput | raw number or `""` | Handler must accept `float \| str` | | Select, SegmentedControl | string value or `None` | Direct value, null→`""` | | MultiSelect, TagsInput, CheckboxGroup | `list[str]` | Direct array | | RadioGroup | `str` | Direct selected value | | DateInput | string or `None` | Null converted to `""` | | Checkbox, Switch | `bool` (checked) | `event.target.checked` extraction | | Slider | `int \| float` | Direct value | | RangeSlider | `list[int \| float]` | Direct list `[min, max]` | | Tabs, Pagination | `str` or `int` | Direct value | | Menu | `bool` (opened state) | via `on_change` | ### NumberInput handler example ```python def set_price(self, val: float | str) -> None: if val == "": self.price = 0.0 return with contextlib.suppress(ValueError): self.price = float(val) ``` ### DateInput handler example ```python def set_date(self, value: str) -> None: self.selected_date = value # "" when cleared, ISO string otherwise ``` ## Component categories **Text inputs**: See [references/inputs-text.md](references/inputs-text.md) — TextInput, NumberInput, PasswordInput, Textarea, MaskedInput, JsonInput, Form (input sub-components) **Selection inputs**: See [references/inputs-selection.md](references/inputs-selection.md) — Select, MultiSelect, Autocomplete, NativeSelect, TreeSelect, TagsInput, RichSelect, ComboboxPopover **Toggle inputs**: See [references/inputs-toggle.md](references/inputs-toggle.md) — Checkbox/CheckboxGroup/CheckboxCard, Radio/RadioGroup/RadioCard, Switch, Chip/ChipGroup, SegmentedControl, Fieldset **Date & time inputs**: See [references/inputs-datetime.md](references/inputs-datetime.md) — DateInput, DatePickerInput, DateTimePicker, InlineDateTimePicker, MonthPickerInput, YearPickerInput, TimeInput, TimePicker, TimeGrid, Calendar, DatePicker, MonthPicker, YearPicker, MiniCalendar **Specialized inputs**: See [references/inputs-specialized.md](references/inputs-specialized.md) — Slider, RangeSlider, FileInput, PinInput, Rating, ColorInput, ColorPicker, HueSlider, AlphaSlider, AngleSlider **Layout**: See [references/layout.md](references/layout.md) — Stack, Group, Flex, Grid, SimpleGrid, Container, Center, Box, Space, Divider, Affix, FocusTrap, AppShell, AspectRatio, Collapse, Marquee, Portal, Scroller, Transition, VisuallyHidden, FloatingWindow, OverflowList, Splitter **Overlays**: See [references/overlays.md](references/overlays.md) — Modal, Drawer, AlertDialog, LoadingOverlay, Overlay, FloatingIndicator, Dialog, Popover **Data display**: See [references/data-display.md](references/data-display.md) — Accordion, Avatar, Badge, Card, Image, BackgroundImage, Paper, Indicator, Timeline, NumberFormatter, RollingNumber, Spoiler, ThemeIcon, ColorSwatch, Kbd, Tooltip, HoverCard, Button, ActionIcon, CloseButton, UnstyledButton, DataList, EmptyState **Feedback & status**: See [references/feedback.md](references/feedback.md) — Alert, Notification, Progress, RingProgress, SemiCircleProgress, Loader, Skeleton **Navigation**: See [references/navigation.md](references/navigation.md) — Breadcrumbs, Pagination, Stepper, Tabs, NavLink, NavigationProgress, Anchor, Burger, TableOfContents, ScrollArea (autosize/autoscroll/stateful), RichTextEditor, MarkdownPreview **Menu**: See [references/menu.md](references/menu.md) — Menu with items, labels, dividers, hover/click triggers, sub-menus, search/checkbox/radio items, context menu, Menubar **Table**: See [references/table.md](references/table.md) — Table with thead/tbody/tr/th/td, sticky header, striped, scroll container, vertical variant **Tree**: See [references/tree.md](references/tree.md) — Hierarchical tree view with search, checkboxes, drag-and-drop **Typography**: See [references/typography.md](references/typography.md) — Text, Title, Code, List, Blockquote, Highlight, Mark, TypographyStylesProvider **Charts**: See Heatmap, Treemap, BarsList, SankeyChart **Schedule** (calendar views): See [references/schedule.md](references/schedule.md) — Schedule, DayView, WeekView, MonthView, YearView, MobileMonthView, ResourcesSchedule, ResourcesDayView, ResourcesWeekView, ResourcesMonthView, AgendaView **Extensions**: See [references/extensions.md](references/extensions.md) — Carousel, Dropzone, ModalsProvider **Maps**: See [references/maps.md](references/maps.md) — Map, MapControls, MapMarker (+content/popup/tooltip/label), MapPopup, MapRoute, MapArc, MapGeoJSON, MapClusterLayer, MapNavigation, MapDirectionsPanel **Theme**: See [references/theme.md](references/theme.md) — create_theme, mantine_provider (scoped theme override), mermaid_zoom_script ## Decision tree **Need a text / number / password input?** → inputs-text.md (`mn.text_input`, `mn.number_input`, `mn.password_input`, `mn.textarea`) **Need a custom input layout (label+description+error)?** → inputs-text.md (`mn.form.wrapper`, `mn.form.label`, `mn.form.error`) **Need a masked or JSON input?** → inputs-text.md (`mn.masked_input`, `mn.json_input`) **Need a dropdown / combobox?** → inputs-selection.md (`mn.select`, `mn.multi_select`, `mn.autocomplete`, `mn.native_select`) **Need a combobox dropdown on a plain button (no input)?** → inputs-selection.md (`mn.combobox_popover`) **Need a tags input?** → inputs-selection.md (`mn.tags_input`) **Need hierarchical selection?** → inputs-selection.md (`mn.tree_select`) **Need a custom-rendered select?** → inputs-selection.md (`mn.rich_select` with `mn.rich_select.map(data, renderer=...)`) **Need a toggle/selector?** → inputs-toggle.md (`mn.segmented_control`, `mn.radio.group`, `mn.checkbox.group`, `mn.chip.group`, `mn.switch`) **Need to group related inputs with a legend?** → inputs-toggle.md (`mn.fieldset`) **Need a date/time picker?** → inputs-datetime.md (`mn.date_picker_input`, `mn.time_picker`, `mn.date_time_picker`, `mn.inline_date_time_picker`) **Need a range / numeric slider?** → inputs-specialized.md (`mn.slider`, `mn.range_slider`) **Need a color picker?** → inputs-specialized.md (`mn.color_input` with text input, `mn.color_picker` standalone, `mn.hue_slider`, `mn.alpha_slider`) **Need file upload?** → inputs-specialized.md (`mn.file_input` button-style) or extensions.md (`mn.dropzone` drag-and-drop) **Need an interactive map (markers, routes, GeoJSON, clustering, turn-by-turn directions)?** → maps.md (`mn.map`, `mn.map.marker`, `mn.map.route`, `mn.map.geojson`, `mn.map.cluster`, `mn.map.navigation`) **Need a PIN / OTP code entry?** → inputs-specialized.md (`mn.pin_input`) **Need a star rating?** → inputs-specialized.md (`mn.rating`) **Need an angle / direction picker?** → inputs-specialized.md (`mn.angle_slider`) **Need layout?** → layout.md (`mn.stack` vertical, `mn.group` horizontal, `mn.flex`, `mn.grid`) **Need a full app shell (header / navbar / footer / aside)?** → layout.md (`mn.app_shell`) **Need fixed aspect ratio container?** → layout.md (`mn.aspect_ratio`) **Need animated show/hide?** → layout.md (`mn.collapse`, `mn.transition`) **Need to render in a different DOM node?** → layout.md (`mn.portal`) **Need scrolling marquee text?** → layout.md (`mn.marquee`) **Need horizontal scroller with controls?** → layout.md (`mn.scroller`) **Need a draggable floating panel?** → layout.md (`mn.floating_window`) **Need to show only first N items + overflow?** → layout.md (`mn.overflow_list`) **Need a resizable split-pane layout?** → layout.md (`mn.splitter`, `mn.splitter.pane`) **Need a screen-reader-only label?** → layout.md (`mn.visually_hidden`) **Need a dialog?** → overlays.md (`mn.modal` centered, `mn.drawer` side panel, `mn.alert_dialog` confirmation, `mn.dialog` small floating panel) **Need a popover anchored to a trigger?** → overlays.md (`mn.popover`) **Need programmatic modal/confirm management?** → extensions.md (`mn.modals_provider`) **Need a loading state?** → overlays.md (`mn.loading_overlay`) or feedback.md (`mn.skeleton`, `mn.loader`) **Need feedback / status messages?** → feedback.md (`mn.alert`, `mn.notification`, `mn.progress`, `mn.ring_progress`, `mn.semi_circle_progress`, `mn.skeleton`) **Need a status label?** → data-display.md (`mn.badge`) **Need an animated rolling counter?** → data-display.md (`mn.rolling_number`) **Need expandable/spoiler content?** → data-display.md (`mn.spoiler`) **Need a colored icon container?** → data-display.md (`mn.theme_icon`) **Need to display a color sample?** → data-display.md (`mn.color_swatch`) **Need a keyboard-key display?** → data-display.md (`mn.kbd`) **Need an X close button?** → data-display.md (`mn.close_button`) **Need a button with zero styling?** → data-display.md (`mn.unstyled_button`) **Need a div with a background image?** → data-display.md (`mn.background_image`) **Need to show label/value pairs (definition list)?** → data-display.md (`mn.data_list`) **Need a "no data" placeholder with a CTA?** → data-display.md (`mn.empty_state`) **Need typography?** → typography.md (`mn.text`, `mn.title`, `mn.list_`, `mn.code`) **Need a styled link?** → navigation.md (`mn.anchor`) **Need a hamburger menu toggle?** → navigation.md (`mn.burger`) **Need a page-section navigator?** → navigation.md (`mn.table_of_contents`) **Need to render highlighted substrings inside text?** → typography.md (`mn.highlight`) **Need a `` inline highlight?** → typography.md (`mn.mark`) **Need a blockquote?** → typography.md (`mn.blockquote`) **Need a dropdown/context menu?** → menu.md (`mn.menu`, `mn.menu.context_menu`) **Need a desktop-style menu bar (File/Edit/View)?** → menu.md (`mn.menubar`) **Need searchable / checkbox / radio menu items?** → menu.md (`mn.menu.search`, `mn.menu.checkbox_item`, `mn.menu.radio_group`) **Need chat/streaming scroll?** → navigation.md (`mn.scroll_area.autoscroll`) **Need tabular data?** → table.md (`mn.table`) **Need hierarchical data?** → tree.md (`mn.tree`) **Need charts?** → charts.md (`mn.line_chart`, `mn.bar_chart`, `mn.area_chart`, `mn.radial_bar_chart`, `mn.sankey_chart`, `mn.bars_list`, etc.) **Need a slideshow / carousel?** → extensions.md (`mn.carousel`) **Need syntax-highlighted code blocks?** → extensions.md (`mn.code_highlight`) **Need a calendar/schedule view?** → schedule.md (`mn.schedule`, `mn.schedule.day_view`, `mn.schedule.week_view`, etc.) **Need a resource scheduler (rooms/people as rows)?** → schedule.md (`mn.resources_schedule`, `mn.resources_day_view`, `mn.resources_week_view`, `mn.resources_month_view`) **Need an agenda list of events by date?** → schedule.md (`mn.agenda_view`) **Need rich text?** → navigation.md (`mn.rich_text_editor` Tiptap-based) **Need to render HTML/Markdown with Mantine typography styles?** → typography.md (`mn.typography_styles_provider`) **Need to customise the theme?** → theme.md (`mn.create_theme` + `mn.mantine_provider`) **Rendering Mermaid diagrams?** → theme.md (`mn.mermaid_zoom_script` to enable click-to-zoom) ## Recent additions (Mantine 9.3 / 9.4) New components: `mn.splitter` (+`.pane`), `mn.data_list`, `mn.empty_state`, `mn.combobox_popover`, `mn.menubar`, `mn.resources_schedule`, `mn.resources_day_view` / `week_view` / `month_view`, `mn.agenda_view`; plus `mn.menu.search` / `checkbox_item` / `radio_group` / `radio_item` / `context_menu` and `mn.popover.context_menu`. New props on existing components: | Component(s) | Prop | |---|---| | All inputs | `success` (green state + optional message, like `error`) | | `mn.text`, `mn.blockquote` | `text_wrap` (`"wrap"|"nowrap"|"balance"|"pretty"|"stable"`) | | `mn.textarea` | `bottom_section` (content inside the border) | | `mn.select`/`multi_select`/`autocomplete`/`tags_input` | `floating_height="viewport"` | | `mn.pagination` | `layout="responsive"` | | `mn.overflow_list` | `collapse_from` (`"start"|"end"`) | | `mn.pie_chart`/`donut_chart` | `labels_type="name"` | | `mn.menu` | `align_items_labels` | | `mn.time_picker` | `close_dropdown_on_preset_select` | | schedule day/week | `with_sub_hour_grid_lines`, `get_current_time`, `with_agenda` | | schedule month | `with_weekend_days`, `with_agenda` | > `prevent_position_change_when_visible` now defaults to `true` on Tooltip / > Popover / Menu (dropdowns stay positioned once opened). ## Recent additions (Mantine 9.5) New components: `mn.cascader` (hierarchical drill-down select, combobox module), `mn.sunburst_chart`, `mn.bullet_chart`, `mn.chart_brush` (charts module); plus `mn.floating_window.resize_handle` (resizable floating windows, layout module). New props on existing components: | Component(s) | Prop | |---|---| | `mn.tooltip` | `interactive` (stays open while pointer moves into it) | | `mn.accordion` | `disable_collapse` (single mode: open item cannot collapse) | | `mn.timeline.item` | `opposite`, `alternate` (centered timeline layout) | | `mn.scroll_area` | `vertical_scrollbar_position` (`"left"|"right"`, RTL) | | `mn.heatmap` | `month_labels_position` (`"top"|"bottom"`) | | date pickers | `with_native_level_select` (native selects in calendar header) | | recharts-based charts | `accessibility_layer` (keyboard navigation, on by default) | | `mn.area_chart`/`bar_chart`/`line_chart`/`composite_chart` | `with_brush`, `brush_props` | | `mn.floating_window` | `dimensions`, `on_size_change`, `on_resize_start` | | `mn.color_input` | `full_width` | 9.5.1 also adds (see module reference docs for the wrapper prop names): a PasswordInput option controlling whether the visibility toggle is focusable, a second Y axis on ScatterChart, YearView custom day rendering and weekend hiding, and ResourcesMonthView event resizing. Fixed in 9.5.x: Tiptap controls no longer start disabled and the source-code control no longer wraps content in an extra `

` tag; Schedule recurring events respect timezones; WeekView event positioning is faster; Combobox works with Chrome autocomplete; Tooltip no longer sets `NaN` positions. ## Critical rules 1. **Never redeclare inherited props** — base classes provide ~40 common props 2. **MantineProvider is auto-injected** — no manual wrapping needed 3. **Use `rx.cond` and `rx.foreach`** — never bare Python `if` or `for` in components 4. **Use `&` and `|`** in `rx.cond`, not `and`/`or` 5. **Controlled vs uncontrolled** — use `value` + `on_change` (controlled) or `default_value` (uncontrolled), not both 6. **Path prefix** — apps served below `frontend_path` (e.g. `/knai`): wrap absolute asset `src` (images, files; not page links) in `public_path("/img/x.png")` (`appkit_commons.public_path`) and every `persist_key` in `app_storage_key("x")` (`appkit_user.authentication.states`). Examples below use bare paths for brevity. ## Namespace components (compound pattern) Some components use namespaces for sub-components: ```python mn.accordion( mn.accordion.item( mn.accordion.control("Section 1"), mn.accordion.panel("Content 1"), value="section-1", ), ) mn.tabs( mn.tabs.list( mn.tabs.tab("Tab 1", value="1"), mn.tabs.tab("Tab 2", value="2"), ), mn.tabs.panel(rx.text("Content 1"), value="1"), mn.tabs.panel(rx.text("Content 2"), value="2"), value=State.active_tab, on_change=State.set_active_tab, ) mn.modal( rx.text("Content"), title="My Modal", opened=State.opened, on_close=State.close_modal, ) ``` ## Mantine style props All layout/input components support Mantine's style system props directly: ```python mn.text_input( label="Email", w="100%", # width maw=400, # max-width mt="md", # margin-top p="sm", # padding bg="gray.0", # background c="dark.9", # color ) ``` Available: `w`, `h`, `miw`, `maw`, `mih`, `mah`, `m`, `my`, `mx`, `mt`, `mb`, `ml`, `mr`, `p`, `py`, `px`, `pt`, `pb`, `pl`, `pr`, `bg`, `c`, `display`, `pos`, `flex`, `opacity`, `fz`, `fw`, `ta`, `td`, `bd`, `hidden_from`, `visible_from`. ## Colors Use the Radix color scale: `.` where shade is 1–12. Higher shade = darker in light mode: ```python c="blue.6" # text color bg="gray.1" # background color bd="red.3" # border color "color": "teal.5" # in chart series dict rx.color("blue", 4) # programmatic color (e.g. for rx.cond results) ``` Common color names: `blue`, `gray`, `red`, `green`, `teal`, `orange`, `violet`, `yellow`, `pink`, `dark`. Use `c="dimmed"` for secondary text. ## Anti-Patterns | Anti-pattern | Correct approach | |---|---| | `rx.vstack` / `rx.hstack` for layout | `mn.stack` / `mn.group` | | `rx.box` as a container | `mn.card` or `mn.paper` | | `rx.text` / `rx.heading` for typography | `mn.text` / `mn.title` | | `mn.list(...)` | `mn.list_(...)` — underscore avoids shadowing Python `list` built-in | | `mn.checkbox_group(...)` | `mn.checkbox.group(...)` — namespace sub-component | | `mn.radio_group(...)` | `mn.radio.group(...)` — namespace sub-component | | `mn.chip_group(...)` | `mn.chip.group(...)` — namespace sub-component | | `mn.popover_target(...)` / `mn.popover_dropdown(...)` | `mn.popover.target(...)` / `mn.popover.dropdown(...)` — namespace | | `mn.dropzone_accept(...)` / `mn.dropzone_idle(...)` | `mn.dropzone.accept(...)` / `mn.dropzone.idle(...)` — namespace | | `mn.app_shell_header(...)` | `mn.app_shell.header(...)` — namespace | | `mn.carousel_slide(...)` | `mn.carousel.slide(...)` — namespace | | Inline styles as strings `style="..."` | Mantine style props: `c="blue.6"`, `fw="bold"`, `p="md"` | | `and` / `or` inside `rx.cond(...)` | Use `&` and `\|` operators | | Bare Python `if` in component functions | `rx.cond(condition, true_comp, false_comp)` | | Bare Python `for` in component functions | `rx.foreach(State.items, render_fn)` | | Custom background on `mn.card` via `background_color`/`--card-bg` | `mn.card` ignores these; wrap in `rx.box` with desired `style` | | `.to_string()` for number display | Use `de_number(value, ...)` from `alloq_commons.components.formatters` | ## ScrollArea variants See [references/navigation.md](references/navigation.md) for full ScrollArea docs. | Variant | When to use | |---|---| | `mn.scroll_area.autosize(...)` | **Preferred for lists** — grows to `mah`, then scrolls | | `mn.scroll_area.autoscroll(...)` | Chat/streaming — auto-scrolls to bottom on new content | | `mn.scroll_area(...)` | Fixed-height scroll container | | `mn.scroll_area.stateful(...)` | Navbar with `persist_key=app_storage_key("navbar_scroll_area")` | ```python mn.scroll_area.autosize( rx.foreach(State.items, item_row), mah=400, type="hover", ) ``` ## German number and date formatting **Always use these helpers — never raw values or `.to_string()`.** ### Numbers ```python from alloq_commons.components.formatters import de_number de_number( emp.hours_per_week, suffix="h/W", size="xs", c="var(--alloq-text-muted)", fw="400" ) # Renders with German separators: 1.234,5 h/W # Props: suffix, prefix, size, c, fw, decimal_scale ``` ### Dates (display) ```python from alloq_commons.components.formatters import format_date_de, format_date_de_named format_date_de(date_var) # → DD.MM.YYYY format_date_de_named(date_var) # → DD. Mon YYYY ``` ### Date inputs ```python mn.date_picker_input( value=State.selected_date, on_change=State.set_date, value_format="DD.MM.YYYY", # Mantine submits in this format too ) # Parse in state — handles both DD.MM.YYYY and ISO YYYY-MM-DD: def _parse_date(value: str) -> date | None: for fmt in ("%d.%m.%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"): try: return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date() except ValueError: continue return None ``` --- **→ For state management, event handlers, background tasks, form validation, page factory, service registry, repository pattern, database models, and project architecture, use the `reflex-state-and-architecture` skill.** ARGUMENTS: popover with target/dropdown inside rx.foreach, tooltip, switch, select props

"""Absence timeline: day-precise bars, week coverage and upcoming absences."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
from alloq_project.components.planning_shared import GRID_WRAPPER_STYLE, MONTH_START_BORDER
from alloq_project.services.planning_gantt import (
    DAYS_PER_WEEK,
    GANTT_BAR_PX,
    GANTT_LANE_PX,
    GANTT_PADDING_PX,
)
from alloq_project.states.planning_absence_state import PlanningAbsenceState
from alloq_project.states.planning_grid_state import PlanningStore
from alloq_project.states.planning_models import (
    WEEK_COL_PX,
    AbsenceGanttBar,
    AbsenceGanttRow,
    CoverageCell,
    GanttMark,
    GanttWeek,
    MonthSpan,
    UpcomingAbsence,
)
from alloq_team.components.employee import absence_modal
from alloq_team.states.team_state import TeamState
from reflex.vars import NumberVar, ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn

GANTT = PlanningStore.absence_gantt
LABEL_PX = 232
SUM_PX = 96
WEEK_PX = f"{WEEK_COL_PX}px"
DAY_PX = WEEK_COL_PX / DAYS_PER_WEEK

BAR_BG = "var(--mantine-color-blue-6)"
WEEKEND_BG = "light-dark(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.025), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03))"
HOLIDAY_HATCH = (
    "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, "
    "light-dark(rgba(135, 88, 0, 0.28), rgba(227, 174, 82, 0.35)) 0 2px, "
    "transparent 2px 4px)"
)
CRITICAL_TINT = "light-dark(rgba(180, 55, 43, 0.05), rgba(255, 122, 107, 0.07))"
LANE_BG = (
    "repeating-linear-gradient(to right, "
    f"transparent 0 {5 * DAY_PX:.3f}px, "
    f"{WEEKEND_BG} {5 * DAY_PX:.3f}px {WEEK_COL_PX - 1}px, "
    f"var(--aq-separator) {WEEK_COL_PX - 1}px {WEEK_COL_PX}px)"
)
NUMERIC = {"fontVariantNumeric": "tabular-nums", "whiteSpace": "nowrap"}
LEVEL_PILL = {
    "neg": ("var(--aq-negative-soft)", "var(--aq-negative)"),
    "warn": ("var(--aq-warning-soft)", "var(--aq-warning)"),
}
HINT = (
    "In einer Zeile ziehen, um eine Abwesenheit einzutragen. "
    "Klick auf einen Balken zeigt die Details."
)


class _AbsenceLane(rx.Component):
    """Timeline lane of one employee; dragging selects a range of days."""

    library = rx.asset("absence_lane.jsx", shared=True).importable_path
    tag = "AbsenceLane"

    day_px: rx.Var[float]
    days: rx.Var[int]
    min_day: rx.Var[int]
    start_iso: rx.Var[str]
    holidays: rx.Var[list[int]]
    on_select_range: rx.EventHandler[lambda start, end: [start, end]]


def _px(value: NumberVar | rx.Var) -> rx.Var[str]:
    return value.to_string() + "px"


def _columns() -> rx.Var[str]:
    return f"{LABEL_PX}px " + _px(GANTT.width_px) + f" {SUM_PX}px"


def _total_width() -> rx.Var[str]:
    return _px(GANTT.width_px + LABEL_PX + SUM_PX)


def _grid_row(*children: rx.Component, style: dict | None = None) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        *children,
        style={
            "display": "grid",
            "gridTemplateColumns": _columns(),
            "width": _total_width(),
            **(style or {}),
        },
    )


def _sticky(side: str, background: str, **extra: str) -> dict:
    border = "borderRight" if side == "left" else "borderLeft"
    return {
        "position": "sticky",
        side: "0",
        "zIndex": "3",
        "backgroundColor": background,
        border: "1px solid var(--aq-border)",
        **extra,
    }


# === Header ===


def _month(month: ObjectVar[MonthSpan], index: NumberVar) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(month.label, fz="12px", fw="650", truncate=True),
        style={
            "width": _px(month.span * WEEK_COL_PX),
            "display": "flex",
            "alignItems": "center",
            "padding": "0 10px",
            "borderLeft": rx.cond(index > 0, MONTH_START_BORDER, "none"),
        },
    )


def _week(week: ObjectVar[GanttWeek]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(
            "KW ",
            week.kw,
            fz="11px",
            fw="650",
            c=rx.cond(week.is_current, "var(--aq-warning)", "var(--aq-text)"),
            style=NUMERIC,
        ),
        mn.group(
            mn.text(week.label, fz="10.5px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)", style=NUMERIC),
            rx.cond(
                week.has_holiday,
                mn.box(w=5, h=5, bg="var(--aq-warning)", style={"borderRadius": "50%"}),
            ),
            gap=3,
            wrap="nowrap",
        ),
        custom_attrs={"title": week.title},
        style={
            "width": WEEK_PX,
            "display": "flex",
            "flexDirection": "column",
            "alignItems": "center",
            "justifyContent": "center",
            "gap": "1px",
            "borderLeft": "1px solid var(--aq-separator)",
            "backgroundColor": rx.cond(week.is_current, "var(--aq-now)", "transparent"),
        },
    )


def _coverage_pill(cell: ObjectVar[CoverageCell], level: str) -> rx.Component:
    background, color = LEVEL_PILL[level]
    return mn.text(
        cell.label,
        fz="11px",
        fw="650",
        c=color,
        px=6,
        py=1,
        bg=background,
        style={**NUMERIC, "borderRadius": "9px"},
    )


def _coverage(cell: ObjectVar[CoverageCell]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        rx.match(
            cell.level,
            ("neg", _coverage_pill(cell, "neg")),
            ("warn", _coverage_pill(cell, "warn")),
            mn.text(cell.label, fz="11px", c="var(--aq-text-tertiary)", style=NUMERIC),
        ),
        custom_attrs={"title": cell.title},
        style={
            "width": WEEK_PX,
            "display": "flex",
            "alignItems": "center",
            "justifyContent": "center",
        },
    )


def _header_label(title: str, hint: rx.Var | str = "") -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(title, fz="12.5px", fw="650"),
        mn.text(hint, fz="11px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)") if hint else rx.fragment(),
        style={
            **_sticky("left", "var(--aq-surface-muted)"),
            "display": "flex",
            "flexDirection": "column",
            "justifyContent": "center",
            "padding": "0 16px",
        },
    )


def _header_sum(text: str = "") -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        mn.text(text, fz="11.5px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)", ta="right"),
        style={
            **_sticky("right", "var(--aq-surface-muted)"),
            "display": "flex",
            "alignItems": "center",
            "justifyContent": "flex-end",
            "padding": "0 16px",
        },
    )


def _header() -> rx.Component:
    line = "1px solid var(--aq-border)"
    return mn.box(
        _grid_row(
            _header_label("Mitarbeiter"),
            mn.box(rx.foreach(PlanningStore.month_spans, _month), display="flex"),
            _header_sum("Summe"),
            style={"height": "28px", "borderBottom": "1px solid var(--aq-separator)"},
        ),
        _grid_row(
            _header_label(GANTT.team_size.to_string() + " Personen"),
            mn.box(rx.foreach(GANTT.weeks, _week), display="flex"),
            _header_sum("Arbeitstage"),
            style={"height": "36px", "borderBottom": line},
        ),
        _grid_row(
            _header_label("Besetzung", "min. anwesend pro Tag"),
            mn.box(rx.foreach(GANTT.coverage, _coverage), display="flex"),
            _header_sum(),
            style={"height": "38px", "borderBottom": line},
        ),
        id="absence-coverage",
        style={
            "position": "sticky",
            "top": "0",
            "zIndex": "30",
            "backgroundColor": "var(--aq-surface-muted)",
            "width": _total_width(),
        },
    )


# === Body ===


def _week_tint(cell: ObjectVar[CoverageCell], index: NumberVar) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        style={
            "width": WEEK_PX,
            "flexShrink": "0",
            "backgroundColor": rx.cond(
                cell.level == "neg",
                CRITICAL_TINT,
                rx.cond(GANTT.weeks[index].is_current, "var(--aq-now)", "transparent"),
            ),
        },
    )


def _holiday(mark: ObjectVar[GanttMark]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        custom_attrs={"title": mark.title},
        style={
            "position": "absolute",
            "top": "0",
            "bottom": "0",
            "left": _px(mark.left_px),
            "width": f"{DAY_PX:.3f}px",
            "backgroundImage": HOLIDAY_HATCH,
        },
    )


def _overlay() -> rx.Component:
    """Week tints, holidays and today line behind the bars."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.box(
            rx.foreach(GANTT.coverage, _week_tint),
            style={"display": "flex", "position": "absolute", "inset": "0"},
        ),
        rx.foreach(GANTT.holidays, _holiday),
        rx.cond(
            GANTT.today_px >= 0,
            mn.box(
                custom_attrs={"title": "Heute"},
                style={
                    "position": "absolute",
                    "top": "0",
                    "bottom": "0",
                    "left": _px(GANTT.today_px),
                    "width": "2px",
                    "marginLeft": "-1px",
                    "backgroundColor": "var(--aq-negative)",
                },
            ),
        ),
        custom_attrs={"aria-hidden": "true"},
        style={
            "position": "absolute",
            "top": "0",
            "bottom": "0",
            "left": f"{LABEL_PX}px",
            "width": _px(GANTT.width_px),
            "pointerEvents": "none",
            "zIndex": "0",
        },
    )


def _stat(value: rx.Var, label: str) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.text(value, fz="18px", fw="700", lh="1.2", style=NUMERIC),
        mn.text(label, fz="11px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)"),
        gap=0,
        px=10,
        py=8,
        bg="var(--aq-surface)",
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "flex": "1"},
    )


def _bar_details(
    row: ObjectVar[AbsenceGanttRow], bar: ObjectVar[AbsenceGanttBar]
) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.stack(
                mn.text(row.name, fz="14px", fw="650"),
                mn.text(bar.period, fz="12.5px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)", style=NUMERIC),
                gap=2,
            ),
            delete_dialog(
                "Abwesenheit löschen",
                f"die Abwesenheit von {row.name} ({bar.period})",
                PlanningAbsenceState.delete_absence(bar.absence_id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                icon_button=True,
                variant="subtle",
                color="red",
                size="md",
                custom_attrs={"aria-label": "Abwesenheit löschen"},
            ),
            justify="space-between",
            align="flex-start",
            wrap="nowrap",
        ),
        mn.group(
            _stat(bar.work_days, "Arbeitstage"),
            _stat(bar.calendar_days, "Kalendertage"),
            gap=8,
            grow=True,
        ),
        rx.cond(
            bar.holidays_note != "",
            mn.text(bar.holidays_note, fz="12px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)"),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            bar.overlap_note != "",
            mn.group(
                rx.icon("triangle-alert", size=15, style={"flexShrink": "0"}),
                mn.text(bar.overlap_note, fz="12px", lh="1.4"),
                gap=8,
                wrap="nowrap",
                align="flex-start",
                px=10,
                py=8,
                c="var(--aq-negative)",
                bg="var(--aq-negative-soft)",
                style={"borderRadius": "8px"},
            ),
        ),
        gap=10,
    )


def _bar(row: ObjectVar[AbsenceGanttRow], bar: ObjectVar[AbsenceGanttBar]) -> rx.Component:
    top = _px(bar.lane * GANTT_LANE_PX + GANTT_PADDING_PX)
    return rx.fragment(
        mn.popover(
            mn.popover.target(
                mn.unstyled_button(
                    rx.cond(
                        bar.inside,
                        mn.text(bar.label, fz="11px", fw="600", truncate=True),
                    ),
                    custom_attrs={"aria-label": bar.aria_label},
                    style={
                        **NUMERIC,
                        "position": "absolute",
                        "zIndex": "1",
                        "top": top,
                        "left": _px(bar.left_px),
                        "width": _px(bar.width_px),
                        "minWidth": "6px",
                        "height": f"{GANTT_BAR_PX}px",
                        "padding": "0 6px",
                        "borderRadius": rx.cond(bar.clipped, "0 4px 4px 0", "4px"),
                        "backgroundColor": BAR_BG,
                        "color": "var(--mantine-color-white)",
                        "cursor": "pointer",
                        "_hover": {"backgroundColor": "var(--mantine-color-blue-7)"},
                        "_focusVisible": {
                            "outline": "2px solid var(--aq-accent)",
                            "outlineOffset": "2px",
                        },
                        "&[data-expanded]": {
                            "boxShadow": (
                                "0 0 0 2px var(--aq-surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--aq-accent)"
                            ),
                        },
                    },
                ),
            ),
            mn.popover.dropdown(
                _bar_details(row, bar),
                bg="var(--aq-surface-muted)",
            ),
            position="bottom-start",
            width=288,
            shadow="md",
            radius="lg",
            with_arrow=True,
            keep_mounted=True,
        ),
        rx.cond(
            bar.inside,
            rx.fragment(),
            mn.text(
                bar.side_label,
                fz="11px",
                c="var(--aq-text-muted)",
                style={
                    **NUMERIC,
                    "position": "absolute",
                    "top": _px(bar.lane * GANTT_LANE_PX + GANTT_PADDING_PX + 3),
                    "left": _px(bar.left_px + bar.width_px + 6),
                    "pointerEvents": "none",
                },
            ),
        ),
    )


def _person(row: ObjectVar[AbsenceGanttRow]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.avatar(name=row.name, size=30, radius="xl", color="initials"),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(row.name, fz="13px", fw="600", truncate=True),
            rx.cond(
                row.job_title != "",
                mn.text(row.job_title, fz="12px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)", truncate=True),
            ),
            gap=0,
            miw=0,
        ),
        gap=10,
        wrap="nowrap",
        style={
            **_sticky("left", "var(--aq-surface)"),
            "padding": "0 16px",
            "minWidth": "0",
        },
    )


def _row(row: ObjectVar[AbsenceGanttRow]) -> rx.Component:
    return _grid_row(
        _person(row),
        _AbsenceLane.create(
            rx.foreach(row.bars, lambda bar: _bar(row, bar)),
            day_px=GANTT.day_px,
            days=GANTT.weeks.length() * DAYS_PER_WEEK,
            min_day=GANTT.min_day,
            start_iso=GANTT.horizon_start,
            holidays=GANTT.holiday_days,
            on_select_range=lambda start, end: PlanningAbsenceState.start_absence(
                row.real_id, start, end
            ),
            style={"position": "relative", "backgroundImage": LANE_BG},
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(row.total_days, fz="13px", fw="650", style=NUMERIC),
            mn.text(row.next_label, fz="11px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)", style=NUMERIC),
            gap=0,
            align="flex-end",
            justify="center",
            style={**_sticky("right", "var(--aq-surface)"), "padding": "0 16px"},
        ),
        style={
            "height": _px(row.height_px),
            "borderBottom": "1px solid var(--aq-separator)",
        },
    )


def _empty() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.text(
            "Keine Abwesenheiten für den gewählten Zeitraum und Filter.",
            fz="13px",
            c="var(--aq-text-muted)",
        ),
        mn.button(
            "Ganzes Team zeigen",
            variant="light",
            size="xs",
            on_click=PlanningStore.set_absence_show_all(True),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
        ),
        align="center",
        gap=10,
        py="xl",
        style={"position": "sticky", "left": "0", "width": "min(100%, 100vw)"},
    )


def _timeline() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        _header(),
        mn.box(
            _overlay(),
            rx.foreach(GANTT.rows, _row),
            rx.cond(
                GANTT.rows.length() > 0,
                _grid_row(
                    mn.box(style=_sticky("left", "var(--aq-surface)")),
                    mn.text(HINT, fz="12px", c="var(--aq-text-tertiary)", pl=12),
                    mn.box(style=_sticky("right", "var(--aq-surface)")),
                    style={"height": "40px", "alignItems": "center"},
                ),
                _empty(),
            ),
            style={"position": "relative", "width": _total_width()},
        ),
        id="planning-gantt-root",
        style=GRID_WRAPPER_STYLE,
    )


# === Footer ===


def _legend_item(swatch: dict, label: str) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.box(style={"width": "18px", "height": "10px", **swatch}),
        mn.text(label, fz="12px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)"),
        gap=6,
        wrap="nowrap",
    )


def _legend() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        _legend_item({"backgroundColor": BAR_BG, "borderRadius": "3px"}, "Abwesenheit"),
        _legend_item(
            {"border": "1.5px dashed var(--aq-accent)", "borderRadius": "3px"},
            "Neu (ziehen)",
        ),
        _legend_item({"width": "10px", "height": "14px", "backgroundImage": HOLIDAY_HATCH}, "Feiertag"),
        _legend_item(
            {
                "width": "10px",
                "height": "14px",
                "backgroundColor": WEEKEND_BG,
                "boxShadow": "inset 0 0 0 1px var(--aq-border)",
            },
            "Wochenende",
        ),
        _legend_item(
            {"width": "2px", "height": "14px", "backgroundColor": "var(--aq-negative)"},
            "Heute",
        ),
        gap="lg",
    )


def _upcoming(item: ObjectVar[UpcomingAbsence]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.avatar(name=item.name, size=28, radius="xl", color="initials"),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(item.name, fz="12.5px", fw="600", truncate=True),
            mn.text(item.period, fz="11.5px", c="var(--aq-text-muted)", style=NUMERIC),
            gap=0,
            miw=0,
            style={"flex": "1"},
        ),
        mn.badge(
            item.relative,
            variant="light",
            color=rx.cond(item.is_running, "blue", "gray"),
            radius="xl",
            tt="none",
            fw=600,
        ),
        gap=10,
        wrap="nowrap",
        px=12,
        py=8,
        bg="var(--aq-surface)",
        style={
            "minWidth": "260px",
            "borderRadius": "10px",
            "boxShadow": "0 0 0 1px var(--aq-border)",
        },
    )


def _footer() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        _legend(),
        rx.cond(
            GANTT.upcoming.length() > 0,
            mn.stack(
                mn.text("Nächste Abwesenheiten", fz="12.5px", fw="650"),
                mn.group(
                    rx.foreach(GANTT.upcoming, _upcoming),
                    gap=10,
                    wrap="nowrap",
                    style={"overflowX": "auto", "paddingBottom": "2px"},
                ),
                gap=8,
            ),
        ),
        gap=12,
        px=16,
        py=12,
        style={"borderTop": "1px solid var(--aq-separator)", "flexShrink": "0"},
    )


def _employee_field() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.select(
        label="Mitarbeiter",
        placeholder="Mitarbeiter wählen",
        data=PlanningStore.employee_select_options,
        value=rx.cond(
            TeamState.selected_employee,
            TeamState.selected_employee.id.to_string(),  # ty: ignore[unresolved-attribute]
            "",
        ),
        on_change=PlanningAbsenceState.pick_employee,
        searchable=True,
        required=True,
        combobox_props={"withinPortal": False},
        w="100%",
    )


def planning_gantt() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        PlanningStore.is_loaded,
        mn.box(
            _timeline(),
            _footer(),
            absence_modal(
                on_submit=PlanningAbsenceState.create_absence,
                employee_field=_employee_field(),
            ),
            style={
                "display": "flex",
                "flexDirection": "column",
                "flex": "1",
                "minHeight": "0",
                "width": "100%",
            },
        ),
        mn.center(
            mn.group(rx.spinner(size="3"), mn.text("Lade Abwesenheiten...", size="sm")),
            py="xl",
        ),
    )

content.text:
I've built the new Abwesenheiten view and its tests, lint and type check pass. I couldn't look at it in a browser. The built-in browser refused localhost, and the other browser tools were busy with another session. The running app has already rebuilt with the changes. Nothing is committed.

**What's in the view now**
- **Bars**: they're placed to the day. Wide bars show their dates inside; narrow ones show them next to the bar, like "21.–25.12. · 4 AT". A bar that starts before the shown range has a straight left edge and says "seit 28.09.".
- **Timeline**: weekends are shaded, public holidays are hatched, a red line marks today, and the current week is tinted.
- **Besetzung row**: it shows the lowest number of people present on any working day of each week. Weeks with someone missing are orange; weeks with half the team or fewer are red. A red chip in the filter row counts these bottlenecks.
- **Summe column**: working days off in the range, plus "ab …" or "bis …" for the next absence.
- **Clicking a bar** shows working days, calendar days, holidays that weren't counted, overlaps with colleagues, and a delete button with a confirmation step.
- **Dragging in a row** opens the absence form with that person and those dates filled in. Dates in the past can't be chosen.
- **Header button** says "Abwesenheit eintragen" in this view. The form then gets a field to choose the employee.
- **Filter row** for this view: time range, people, roles, a "Ganzes Team zeigen" switch, and chips for total days off and bottlenecks.
- **Below the grid**: a legend and a "Nächste Abwesenheiten" list.

**One rule I changed:** "Nur verfügbare" and the project filter no longer apply in this view, because their controls are gone there. An existing test required the opposite, so I updated it in [test_planning_availability_filter.py](components/alloq-project/tests/test_planning_availability_filter.py).

**Not built:**
- "Heute" with ‹ › buttons, because the planning range always starts at the current week.
- "Bearbeiten" in the bar details, because the app has no way to edit an absence yet.
- Holiday names, because only the dates are loaded.

**Where the code is:** the logic is in [planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/services/planning_gantt.py) under services. The view's state is in a new [planning_absence_view_mixin.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/states/planning_absence_view_mixin.py), so the grid state doesn't grow. Dragging is handled by [absence_lane.jsx](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/absence_lane.jsx).

**Before committing:** another session is working on the heatmap in this same checkout. It edits `planning_grid_state.py` and `planning_models.py`, which I also changed in small places. Commit the two together carefully so neither set of changes is lost.

def compute_gesamt(weeks: list[WeekColumn], block: EmployeeBlock) -> list[GesamtCell]:
    cells: list[GesamtCell] = []
    for idx, week in enumerate(weeks):
        used = sum(p.cells[idx].value for p in block.projects)
        absence = block.absence.cells[idx].value if block.absence.cells else 0.0
        internal = block.internal.cells[idx].value if block.internal.cells else 0.0
        work = scaled_work_days(week, block.workload_percent)
        result = UtilizationService.compute_employee_gesamt(
            used_days=used,
            absence_days=absence,
            internal_days=internal,
            work_days=work,
        )
        cells.append(
            GesamtCell(
                week_key=week.key,
                value=result.free_days,
                bucket=result.bucket,
                state=gesamt_state(result.free_days),
                has_absence=result.has_absence,
                breakdown=gesamt_breakdown(
                    work, used, internal, absence, result.free_days
                ),
            )
        )
    return cells

) -> tuple[list[AffectedProject], str, str]:
    """Projects booked in the absence weeks and whether those weeks overflow."""
    indexes = _affected_weeks(period, weeks)
    projects: list[AffectedProject] = []
    for project in block.projects:
        if project.is_internal:
            continue
        booked = [i for i in indexes if i < len(project.cells) and project.cells[i].value > 0]
        if booked:
            projects.append(
                AffectedProject(
                    name=project.name or project.code,
                    color=project.color,
                    days_label=_pt(sum(project.cells[i].value for i in booked)),
                    weeks=_kw_list(weeks, booked),
                )
            )
    over = [
        i for i in indexes if i < len(block.gesamt) and block.gesamt[i].state == "over"
    ]
    if over:
        worst = -min(block.gesamt[i].value for i in over)
        text = (
            f"{_kw_list(weeks, over)} überbucht um {_pt(worst)}"
            if len(over) == 1
            else f"{_kw_list(weeks, over)} überbucht, bis {_pt(worst)} zu viel"
        )
        return projects, "neg", text
    if projects:
        return projects, "ok", "Kapazität reicht"
    return projects, "none", "Keine Projekte eingeplant"

    resources: list[_Resource], horizon: _Horizon, weeks: list[WeekColumn]
) -> list[UpcomingAbsence]:

content.text:
I made all three changes. The 542 tests, lint and the type check pass, but I couldn't look at the result: the browser tools are still in use by the other session. Please reload the view and check it.

**Besetzung row:** removed from the header. I also removed the red tint it put on bottleneck weeks, because without the row nothing explained it. Two parts still use the same calculation. The "Engpass" chip in the filter row still shows, and the bar details still mention the bottleneck in the overlap note. Say if those should go too.

**Month borders:** they now look like the other views.
- Strong lines at month starts, running through the week header and all person rows.
- Strong lines beside the name column and the "Summe" column.
- A 2px line under the header.
- Normal row lines.

The week lines now sit on the left edge of each week so they line up with the header.

**"Nächste Abwesenheiten":** I kept it, because it can now show something the bars can't: what the absence means for the planning. Each card is bigger and shows:
- Name, dates, working days, and "in 4 Tagen" or "läuft bis …".
- A status line: red "KW 41 überbucht um 1,5 PT" if those weeks are overbooked, green "Kapazität reicht" if not, or "Keine Projekte eingeplant".
- The projects booked in those weeks, with their color, PT and KW. Internal projects are left out.

The PT shown are for the whole week, not only the days off, so the KW is shown next to them. The section now sits below the rows and scrolls down with them, so the grid keeps its height. It stays the width of the screen and doesn't scroll sideways. The legend and the drag hint stay in the small bar at the bottom.

The changes are in [planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_gantt.py) (the view) and [planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/services/planning_gantt.py) (the project and overbooking logic), with new tests in [test_planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/tests/test_planning_gantt.py).

content.text:
The month lines should now show in the rows. I couldn't check it in a browser, so please reload the view and look.

The cause was that each row draws its own thin week line on the left edge of every week. At a month start, that line sits on the same pixel as the month line, and since the month line was drawn behind the rows, the week line covered it. The header showed it because the header has no rows on top. Now each row draws the month lines itself, above the week lines and below the bars.

The change is in [planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_gantt.py), with the line positions computed in the gantt service. Lint, the type check and the project tests pass.

The project test count went from 469 to 420. That comes from the other session's heatmap work: it deleted `planning_heatmap.py` and removed tests from `test_planning_project_view_state.py`. All of my absence tests are still there. I also ran the formatter over the whole `alloq-project` folder, which may have reformatted some of that session's files; it reformats only, without changing what the code does.
